title: The Water Line Moves a Little
premise: In a parked-car close-up, a refill bottle's water line drops between checks. The camera records the tiny change without explaining where the sips went.

title: The Cap's Brief Vacation
premise: At an ordinary refill stop, the bottle cap is set down, picked up, and screwed back on. The edit repeats this quiet intermission as if the cap has traveled somewhere.

title: Two Ice Cubes Settle Again
premise: A clear cup shows two ice cubes shifting when it is lifted and settling when it is set down while parked. The edit repeats the same small movement from three angles.

title: Free Ice Water, Kept in Frame
premise: At Wall Drug, we film one cup of its free ice water beside the refill source, then watch the ice melt before anyone finishes the cup. It is a complete water story with a very small middle.

title: Room Temperature Has No Plot
premise: A bottle of water rests in shade while the camera returns to it at ordinary breaks. Each update says only that it is less cold than before.

title: The Empty Bottle's Last Swirl
premise: After a refill bottle empties, a thin film of water traces the base when it is tilted while parked. The video inspects three tilts before stopping.

title: Which Vessel Stays Cold Until the Next Stop?
premise: A plain cup and an insulated bottle start with the same cold water and get checked at every stop. By the third stop, only one of them is still worth drinking.

title: The Wide-Mouth Bottle Wins at Refill Time
premise: At three refill stops, the wide-mouth bottle takes its ice in one scoop while the narrow one takes it a cube at a time. That's the whole video. It holds up.

title: The Bottle Dries Before the Drink Warms
premise: A chilled bottle sweats, then dries off over a few stops while the water inside stays cold. The outside of a bottle is a bad thermometer.

title: The Bottle Everyone Reaches For
premise: A clear plastic bottle and a pricey insulated one start the trip as equals. By the end everyone grabs the clear one, because you can see how much is left, and the insulated bottle rides in the door pocket, cold and ignored.
